dimensions.name: Income statement and profitability
dimensions.minimum_contract: Reported income/NII/noninterest income,costs,PBT/PAT,ROTE/ROE; signed statutory/APM bridges; no universal profitability threshold

dimensions.name: Balance sheet
dimensions.minimum_contract: Assets/liabilities/equity, gross/net lending, carrying values; point-in-time date and accounting/legal perimeter

dimensions.name: Deposits,lending,funding
dimensions.minimum_contract: Total/customer/retail/central-items deposits, loans/funding,mix/maturity and stock movements; never equate stock change with cash flow

dimensions.name: Capital,liquidity,risk
dimensions.minimum_contract: CET1,leverage,LCR/NSFR,RWA,arrears/credit concentrations; regulatory scope and average/as-at denominators

dimensions.name: Revenue and cost structure
dimensions.minimum_contract: NII/fees/otherincome,segment mix,ordinary cost/remediation/restructuring; gross/net efficiency and intragroup treatment

dimensions.name: Credit impairment
dimensions.minimum_contract: Signed ECL/impairment charge versus stock allowance,coverage/costofrisk; acquired day-one effects and denominator definitions

dimensions.name: Cash flow where meaningful
dimensions.minimum_contract: Actual cash-flow statement and definition where useful; bank funding/liquidity complementary; no deposit-based FCF proxy

dimensions.name: Strategic investment and transformation
dimensions.minimum_contract: Incurred expense/capitalised investment/intragroup funding/commitment/target/realised benefit; never addressable supplierbudget by default

dimensions.name: Trends
dimensions.minimum_contract: Within-issuer restated same-definition time series, duration,scope,FX and acquisition bridges; no blind annualisation

dimensions.name: Comparisons
dimensions.minimum_contract: Comparability dossier before arithmetic/ranking: entity,perimeter,basis,currency,unit,temporal kind/dates and businessmodel; unmatched values sideby-side labelled only
